scope: CPU MT19937 canonical full-state and specified unit uniform/integer transforms; not complete PyTorch RNG.

cpython_report.raw32_reference_boundary: Full std::mt19937 and CPython engine comparison; PyTorch raw32 projection additionally verifies low31 outputs and full serialized state. Raw64 is directly compared to PyTorch full signed random_ range.
cpython_report.invalid_state_boundary: Malformed/inconsistent MT positions and nonboolean cache flags are explicitly refused; no claim of reproducing undefined or unsafe upstream malformed-state behavior.

flat_abi_report.scope: Qualification calls the existing six-word bridge directly; stdin executable normally provides 1 MiB output and cannot trigger these short-output cases.

release_source_equivalence.change: The release commit adds five lines under [tool.ruff], setting target-version to py310 with explanatory comments. There are no deletions. Every other root entry and every source subtree is identical.
release_source_equivalence.scope: Only this exact official wheel SHA256/build commit and this exact inventory release commit. This is source equivalence for the recorded lint-only release change, not identity of the two Git commits or an allowance for other builds.
